sents.en: Mother woke me up very early.

sents.zh: 她说：“如果去晚了，好东西就没有了。”
sents.en: She said: "If we go late, the good things will be gone."

sents.zh: 我们八点出门，走了二十分钟才到。
sents.en: We left at eight, and it took twenty minutes to get there.

sents.zh: 市场里已经有很多人了。
sents.en: There were already many people at the market.

sents.zh: 有人卖水果，有人卖鱼，也有人卖菜。
sents.en: Some sold fruit, some sold fish, and some sold vegetables.

sents.zh: 卖水果的人说：“今天的苹果又红又好吃。”
sents.en: The fruit seller said: "Today’s apples are red and delicious."

sents.zh: 我看了看，觉得他说得对。
sents.en: I looked, and thought he was right.

sents.zh: 妈妈问了问要多少钱，然后买了六个。
sents.en: Mother asked how much they cost, then bought six.

sents.zh: 我们又去了卖鱼的地方。
sents.en: We went to the fish stall as well.

sents.zh: 那里的鱼很新，因为是今天早上刚到的。
sents.en: The fish there was fresh, because it had only arrived that morning.

sents.zh: 东西越来越多，我帮妈妈拿了两个包。
sents.en: There were more and more things, so I carried two bags for her.

sents.zh: 回家的路上，我们买了两块面包。
sents.en: On the way home we bought two pieces of bread.

sents.zh: 到了家，妈妈就开始做饭。
sents.en: Once home, Mother started to cook.

sents.zh: 虽然今天走了很多路，但是我很高兴。
sents.en: Although we walked a lot today, I was very happy.
